editionLabel: White Wizard Games English rules sheet, 2013
firstPlayerRule: Randomly determine who plays first. The first player starts with a 3-card hand; the second player draws 5.
clarifications: In the two-player game, players alternate turns.
Free-For-All and Hunter (3+ players): randomly choose the first player, who draws 3 cards; play goes clockwise, the second player draws 4, and everyone else draws 5.
Hydra team games: randomly choose which team goes first; that team’s players draw 3 cards and the other team’s draw 5.
Raid: play starts with the Boss and proceeds clockwise.

Page 1 (Two Player Rules): ‘Randomly determine which player will play first. That player draws three cards … The player going second draws five cards’, then players alternate turns. Page 3 (Multiplayer Rules): Free-For-All and Hunter randomly determine the first player (3/4/5-card hands, clockwise); Hydra randomly determines the first team; Emperor gives Team A three cards; Raid starts with the Boss. Both sheets are footed Star Realms © 2013 White Wizard Games LLC and list 80 Trade Deck cards, identifying the base Star Realms deckbuilding game (BGG 147020).
